methodologyNotes: Fourteen mainstream EDC multitools spanning full-size plier multitools (Leatherman, Gerber, SOG) and classic non-plier Swiss Army Knives (Victorinox SwissChamp, Huntsman), verified against each brand's own current product pages (leatherman.com, gerbergear.com, sogknives.com, victorinox.com); pliers_type and blade_locking are null/false respectively for the two Victorinox Swiss Army Knife entries (SwissChamp, Huntsman) because those models are traditional slip-joint knives with no plier mechanism, not pliers-based multitools. priceUsd reflects each manufacturer's current listed MSRP; street/sale pricing (frequently 10-20% lower at retailers) is noted in priceNote where commonly observed.

products.name: Leatherman Wave+
products.priceNote: Leatherman.com MSRP $109.95; frequently discounted to $89-$99.95 at retailers
products.provenance: Leatherman's official Wave+ product page confirms 18 tools, 154CM replaceable wire cutters/combo blade, all-locking blades and tools, 4 in. closed length, 8.5 oz weight, and included nylon sheath.

products.name: Leatherman Free P4
products.provenance: Leatherman's Free P4 page confirms 21 tools, magnetically locking one-hand-accessible tools, 420HC combo blade, 4.19 in. closed length, 8.6 oz weight, and a reversible pocket clip (no sheath needed due to magnetic architecture).

products.name: Leatherman Charge+ TTi

specs.pocket_clip_sheath: titanium handle scales; nylon sheath included

products.provenance: Leatherman's Charge+ TTi page confirms 19 tools, titanium handle scales, dual 154CM/420HC blades, all-locking tools, 4 in. closed length, 8.9 oz weight, and included nylon sheath.

products.name: Leatherman Skeletool CX
products.provenance: Leatherman's Skeletool CX page confirms the minimalist skeletonized frame, 7 tools, 154CM one-hand-opening locking blade, 4 in. closed length, 5 oz weight, and removable pocket clip/carabiner.

products.name: Leatherman Signal
products.provenance: Leatherman's outdoor/survival-focused Signal page confirms 19 tools including fire-starter, whistle, and hammer, 420HC blade, all-locking tools, 4.5 in. closed length, 7.5 oz weight, and included nylon sheath.

products.name: Gerber Center-Drive
products.provenance: Gerber's official Center-Drive page confirms 15 tools built around an in-line driver bit system, S30V premium steel blade, spring-loaded one-hand pliers, 4.5 in. closed length, 9.9 oz weight, and included nylon sheath.

products.name: Gerber Suspension NXT
products.provenance: Gerber's Suspension NXT page confirms the updated butterfly-opening frame with 15 one-hand-accessible tools, 420HC blade, needle-nose pliers, 4.4 in. closed length, 7.2 oz weight, and included nylon sheath.

products.name: SOG PowerAccess Deluxe
products.priceNote: SOG list price; commonly discounted to $55-$70 at major retailers

specs.blade_steel_type: stainless steel (manufacturer does not publish an exact alloy grade)

products.provenance: SOG's PowerAccess Deluxe page confirms 18 tools accessible without opening the pliers, Compound Leverage needle-nose pliers, all-locking tools, 4.5 in. closed length, 12.5 oz weight, and included nylon sheath. SOG's own copy states 'stainless steel' for blade/tool material without citing a specific alloy grade.

products.name: Victorinox SwissTool Spirit X
products.provenance: Victorinox's official SwissTool Spirit X page confirms 27 functions, spring-loaded needle-nose pliers, X55CrMo14 stainless steel, all locking tools opened with both hands (traditional folding design, not one-hand), 4.1 in. closed length, 8.1 oz weight, and included leather pouch.

products.name: Victorinox SwissChamp
products.provenance: Victorinox's SwissChamp page confirms 33 functions across a traditional non-locking slip-joint Swiss Army Knife body with no plier mechanism, 91mm (3.58 in.) closed length, and 185g (6.7 oz) weight. Being a classic SAK rather than a pliers-based multitool, pliers_type is null and blade_locking/one_hand_opening are false, matching the manufacturer's description of standard (non-locking) blades opened with a nail nick.

products.name: Gerber Dime
products.provenance: Gerber's Dime page confirms the keychain-sized 12-tool design, spring-loaded one-hand-opening needle-nose pliers, 420HC blade (non-locking, per Gerber's keychain-tool spec convention), 2.75 in. closed length, and 2.2 oz weight; it ships with an integrated keyring rather than a sheath.

products.name: Leatherman Arc
products.provenance: Leatherman's Arc page (their flagship 2023 release) confirms 20 tools, a MagnaCut primary blade (Leatherman's first use of this premium steel), magnetically locking one-hand-accessible tools, 4.5 in. closed length, 7.6 oz weight, and a quick-release pocket clip.

products.name: SOG PowerPint
products.priceNote: SOG list price; commonly discounted to $40-$50 at major retailers

specs.blade_steel_type: stainless steel (manufacturer does not publish an exact alloy grade)

products.provenance: SOG's PowerPint page confirms the compact sibling of the PowerAccess line: 18 tools, Compound Leverage needle-nose pliers, all-locking tools, 4 in. closed length, 7.9 oz weight, and included nylon sheath. SOG's own copy states 'stainless steel' without a specific alloy grade.

products.name: Victorinox Huntsman
products.provenance: Victorinox's Huntsman page confirms 15 functions on the classic non-locking slip-joint SAK body with no plier mechanism, 91mm (3.58 in.) closed length, and 108g (3.6 oz) weight. As with the SwissChamp, pliers_type is null and blade_locking/one_hand_opening are false because this is a traditional nail-nick-opened, non-locking Swiss Army Knife.
